changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.EXCEPTION_QUEUE ( EXCEPTION_ID NUMBER(19) GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, RESULT_ID NUMBER(19) NOT NULL, REASON VARCHAR2(64 CHAR) NOT NULL, STATUS VARCHAR2(16 CHAR) DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL CONSTRAINT CK_EXC_STATUS CHECK (STATUS IN ('OPEN','CLAIMED','RESOLVED','REJECTED')), CLAIMED_BY VARCHAR2(64 CHAR), CLAIMED_AT TIMESTAMP(6), RESOLVED_BY VARCHAR2(64 CHAR), RESOLVED_AT TIMESTAMP(6), RESOLUTION_JSON CLOB CONSTRAINT CK_RESOLN_JSON CHECK (RESOLUTION_JSON IS JSON), CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP(6) DEFAULT SYSTIMESTAMP NOT NULL, VERSION NUMBER(10) DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_EXCEPTION PRIMARY KEY (EXCEPTION_ID), CONSTRAINT FK_EXC_RESULT FOREIGN KEY (RESULT_ID) REFERENCES TFPM_ADDR_ENRICH.STRUCTURING_RESULTS(RESULT_ID), CONSTRAINT CK_EXC_REASON CHECK (REASON IN ('LOW_CONFIDENCE','MISSING_REQUIRED','UNSTRUCTURABLE','MANUAL_REVIEW')) );
